description: This file defines the US English culture information for the Date.js library, including date and time formats, month and day names, regex patterns for parsing dates, and prototype methods for date manipulation within the library.

classes.name: Date.CultureInfo
classes.description: An object containing locale-specific information for date formatting, parsing, and culture-specific methods.

methods.name: setTimezone
methods.description: Sets the timezone for the date object.
